title: Bolt vs v0: Which AI Builder Should You Choose?
summary: Bolt.new vs v0 by Vercel — honest comparison of output type, pricing, and backend. Plus the full-stack option most builders end up choosing: Blink.
body_markdown: Bolt is more beginner-friendly for greenfield apps — the in-browser environment has no setup, and the full-stack output gives you something that works immediately. v0 is better for beginners already familiar with React who want to generate specific components. For beginners who want to skip configuration entirely,[Blink](https://blink.new/) is usually the fastest path to a deployed app — describe your idea and the full stack ships, no infrastructure decisions required.
